Final project

Study of Hazardous Waste (B3) and Specific Waste Management in Higher Education Facilities

Undergraduate thesis, ITS | January – July 2026 | Regulatory basis: PP No. 22/2021 and Permen LHK No. 6/2021

Document and regulatory reviewPertek and TPS LB3 documents; PP 22/2021; Permen LHK 6/2021
Field observationPackaging, labels, symbols, storage, and collection at 9 B3-generating units
Interviews and questionnairesB3 managers; specific waste interviews with 38 departments
Compliance assessmentCompliance matrices; 15 TPS LB3 technical criteria; waste types vs. Pertek
Inventory and recommendationsSpecific waste inventory, composition sampling, and corrective actions

Key findings and recommendations

14 / 15

TPS LB3 technical criteria met (93.33%)

3 / 5

Collection and transport requirements met

508.238

kg/year potential B3-containing specific waste

Specific waste with B3 potential (kg/year)

B3 manager understanding (%)

Key findings

  • Packaging non-conformities in all observed B3 units (container, closure, labels)
  • Collection: transport equipment and consistent PPE use not met
  • Generating units differ from the Technical Approval (Pertek)
  • B3-containing items found mixed in general waste

Recommendations

  • Periodic inventory of B3 and specific waste
  • Dedicated segregation and collection for specific waste
  • Traceability records (logbook or digital)
  • Standard containers, labels, SOPs, secondary containment

Source: undergraduate thesis (2026), results and conclusions chapters.
